verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents offline on-device LLM chat (ChatMessage conversations, no-network operation) and tool calling. Nothing in the pack mentions document ingestion, embeddings, vector search or automatic retrieval-augmented generation. Offline chat and tool calling are only building blocks a developer could use to build RAG, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
